name: Dr. Siba Dolai, PhD
topic: The Role of Gut Microbiome in Health and Disease
profile: Dr. Siba Dolai is a microbiome researcher and clinical scientist based in Australia. His work focuses on understanding the role of gut microorganisms in health, disease prevention, and personalized medicine. He is actively involved in advancing microbiome research and translating scientific discoveries into practical healthcare applications.

name: Dr. Vijay Murthy, MD
profile: Dr. Vijay Murthy specializes in microbiome science and metabolic health. His research explores the relationship between microbial ecosystems and human physiology, helping bridge emerging microbiome science with clinical practice and personalized healthcare.

name: Dr. Sanjay Sachdeva, MD
topic: The Gut Hears Every Thought: How Thoughts, Emotions and Beliefs Shape the Microbiome, Digestion and Healing
profile: Dr. Sanjay Sachdeva is an internationally recognized integrative medicine practitioner focusing on the gut-brain connection, emotional health, mind-body medicine, and their impact on digestive wellness. His work highlights the profound influence of mental and emotional states on gut function and overall health.

name: Dr. Tom O'Bryan, DC, CCN, DACBN, CIFM
credentials: Functional Medicine Expert | Autoimmune Disease Specialist | International Speaker
profile: Dr. Tom O'Bryan is one of the world's leading experts on gluten sensitivity, autoimmunity, and functional medicine. Through decades of research and clinical practice, he has helped healthcare professionals and patients understand the critical relationship between gut health, immune dysfunction, and chronic disease prevention.

name: Dr. Praveen Jacob, BNYS, MSc Biochemistry, PhD Scholar
credentials: Naturopathic Physician | Gut Health Educator | Functional Medicine Practitioner | CEO, Alpha Naturals | International Speaker
topic: Prebiotics and Their Role in Health
profile: Dr. Praveen Jacob is a Naturopathic Physician, Functional Medicine Practitioner, and CEO of Alpha Naturals. He holds a Master's degree in Biochemistry and is currently pursuing his PhD. He specializes in clinical nutrition, gut health, microbiome science, and preventive medicine. His work emphasizes the therapeutic role of prebiotics in supporting digestive, metabolic, immune, and microbiome health. As an international speaker on gut microbes and evidence-based natural healthcare, he actively educates healthcare professionals and the public on emerging advances in microbiome science and functional medicine.

name: Dr. Somashekhar Huddar, BAMS
credentials: Family Physician | Educator | Public Health Advocate
topic: Gut Health: An Ayurvedic Perspective – Agni & Grahani
profile: Dr. Somashekhar Huddar is a senior Ayurvedic physician with over 22 years of clinical experience. He has treated more than 500 infertility cases, 1,000 renal calculus cases, and over 5,000 skin disorder cases. He has organized more than 125 free health camps, 5 mega blood donation camps, delivered over 100 public health awareness talks, and has 9.5 years of teaching experience in Pharmaceutics. He currently serves as State General Secretary of AFI Karnataka and Secretary of Sanjeevini Ayurveda Medical College & Hospital, Hubli.

name: Dr. Mili Shah, MD
credentials: Ozone Therapy Specialist | Integrative Medicine Consultant
profile: Dr. Mili Shah is a clinician specializing in ozone therapy and integrative healthcare. Her work focuses on utilizing advanced therapeutic approaches to improve digestive health, inflammation management, and overall systemic wellness.

name: Dr. Alejandro Diaz, MD
profile: Dr. Alejandro Diaz is an international speaker and researcher studying the interaction between the nervous system, microbiome, and digestive health. His work highlights the importance of the gut-brain axis in modern healthcare and disease prevention.

name: Daryl Turner
credentials: Functional Health Educator | Autoimmune Health Specialist
topic: Hashimoto's and Stress Impact on Gut Health
profile: Daryl Turner is a health educator focusing on autoimmune disorders, thyroid health, stress physiology, and their influence on gut function. He is widely recognized for his practical approach to chronic disease management and patient education.
